verdict.rationale: First-party docs show several in-product AI insight and suggestion features. Granola Chat answers questions with insights from notes and transcripts and spots patterns across calls. Recipes provide reusable insight prompts. Overnight pre-meeting briefs surface open threads and context, and the product auto-drafts follow-up emails. AI-enhanced notes link back to their source in the transcript. Independent support is limited to one community comment calling the summarisation highly capable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Chat insights, recipes and briefs beyond summarisation quality.
